name: veterinary_clinic_system_059_species_visit_mix_report
instruction: Produce the data behind the Visits by Species report. One ops_reports row per species that appears among patients with at least one visit: {report: 'visits_by_species', batch_code, species, visits: <count of visit_records whose patient has that species>, distinct_patients: <distinct patients of that species with visits>, pct_of_visits: <round(100*visits/total_visits,1)>}. Any order.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute via patients join; exact ints; pct within 0.05 each; row set == species present; nonce.

checks.expect: Recompute via patients join; exact ints; pct within 0.05 each; row set == species present; nonce.

domain_searches.query: AAHA canine vaccination guidelines rabies DHPP bordetella booster interval adult dog
top_results: 2022 AAHA Core and Noncore Vaccines for Dogs (Table 2)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Join-driven aggregation mirroring the app's report screen; species with zero visits must be absent (not zero-rows).
